def _write_bundle(directory, files, target):
    """Write the source manifest and every companion without extracting a packet."""
    pending = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=directory, prefix=".source-", suffix=".zip",
                                         delete=False) as temporary:
            pending = Path(temporary.name)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pending, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
                             compresslevel=5, allowZip64=True) as archive:
            for name, descriptor in sorted(files.items()):
                source = verify_file(directory, descriptor)
                info = zipfile.ZipInfo(_relative(name), date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
                with source.open("rb") as stream, archive.open(info, "w", force_zip64=True) as out:
                    for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                        out.write(block)
                verify_file(directory, descriptor)
        if target.exists():
            if target.stat().st_size != pending.stat().st_size or file_digest(target) != file_digest(pending):
                raise ValueError("Retained report-source bundle differs")
            pending.unlink()
        else:
            pending.replace(target)
        pending = None
    finally:
        if pending is not None:
            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _verify_source(workspace, value):
    choice = value["source"]
    unused, entry = workspace.source_file(choice["source_collection_id"], choice["source_id"])
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != observed_context.ROLE
            or not _same_file(entry["body"], value["files"]["recipe"])):
        raise ValueError("The original report recipe source differs from its receipt")
    actual = {item.get("view_path", item["filename"]): item
              for item in entry.get("companions", [])}
    expected = value["members"]
    if len(actual) != len(entry.get("companions", [])) or set(actual) != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Original report source companion membership differs")
    for name, item in expected.items():
        if not _same_file(actual[name], item):
            raise ValueError("Original report source companion differs: " + name)
    current = observed_context.bind(workspace, {"source_roles": {observed_context.ROLE: choice}})
    if current != value["observed_binding"]:
        raise ValueError("Original scientific-report source binding differs")
    return value


def get(workspace, key):
    """Reopen the same completed imported source and verify all retained members."""
    key = identifier(key)
    value = read_json(workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key / "receipt.json")
    if (value.get("schema") != SCHEMA or value.get("state") != "complete"
            or value.get("id") != key or digest(value.get("selection")) != key
            or value["selection"].get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or value.get("ledger_id") != value["selection"].get("ledger_id")):
        raise ValueError("The retained Land-cover report-source identity differs")
    for item in value["files"].values():
        verify_file(workspace.root, item)
    for item in value["members"].values():
        verify_file(workspace.root, item)
    return _verify_source(workspace, value)


def list_sources(workspace, ledger_id=None):
    """Return completed receipt metadata without re-reading source bodies."""
    if ledger_id is not None:
        ledger_id = identifier(ledger_id)
    root = workspace.root / DIRECTORY
    if not root.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(root.glob("*/receipt.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if (value.get("schema") != SCHEMA or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or path.parent.name != value.get("id")
                or digest(value.get("selection")) != value["id"]
                or value["selection"].get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
                or value.get("ledger_id") != value["selection"].get("ledger_id")):
            raise ValueError("A Land-cover report-source receipt differs")
        if ledger_id is not None and value["ledger_id"] != ledger_id:
            continue
        rows.append({key: _copy(value[key]) for key in (
            "id", "ledger_id", "title", "state", "source", "created_at", "files",
        )})
    return rows


def prepare(workspace, spec):
    """Prepare the existing report composer source from one complete saved ledger."""
    if not isinstance(spec, dict) or set(spec) - {"ledger_id", "title"}:
        raise ValueError("Supply the original ledger_id and optional report-source title")
    state = landcover_workspace.inspect(workspace, identifier(spec.get("ledger_id")))
    edition, binding, report = state["edition"], state["binding"], state["report"]
    if edition.get("state") != "complete" or report.get("complete") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed original land-cover ledger")
    from . import landcover_report_figures
    figure_implementation = {name: item["sha256"]
                             for name, item in landcover_report_figures.implementation().items()}
    title = _title(spec.get("title", edition["title"]))
    originals = _original_sources(workspace, binding)
    native_members = _run_members(workspace, binding, report)
    sections = _sections(edition, binding, report, originals)
    original_root = workspace.root / landcover_workspace.KIND / edition["id"]
    edition_file = describe_file(workspace.root, original_root / "edition.json")
    identity = {
        "edition": EDITION, "producer_sha256": file_digest(__file__),
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "ledger_id": edition["id"],
        "title": title, "ledger_edition": edition_file, "signature": report["signature"],
        "source_entries": originals, "native_raster_members": native_members,
        "figure_implementation": figure_implementation,
    }
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    with held(directory / ".source.lock", blocking=False):
        receipt = directory / "receipt.json"
        if receipt.exists():
            return {**get(workspace, key), "reused": True}
        members = {}
        def retain(name, descriptor):
            name = _relative(name)
            if name in members:
                if not _same_file(members[name], descriptor):
                    raise ValueError("Report source members collide: " + name)
                return
            copied = copy_verified(workspace.root, descriptor, directory, path=name)
            members[name] = describe_file(directory, directory / copied["path"])
        def write(name, value):
            name = _relative(name)
            if name in members:
                raise ValueError("Report source member names collide")
            path = destination_file(directory, name)
            atomic_json(path, value, immutable=True)
            members[name] = describe_file(directory, path)
        retain("ledger/edition.json", edition_file)
        for role, item in sorted(edition["files"].items()):
            original_path = verify_file(original_root, item)
            retain("ledger/" + _relative(item["path"]),
                   describe_file(workspace.root, original_path))
        write("records/source-bindings.json", {"schema": "upstate.landcover-report-originals/v1",
                                              "ledger_id": edition["id"], "sources": originals,
                                              "native_raster_members": native_members})
        for original in originals:
            prefix = "originals/" + original["source_collection_id"] + "/" + digest(original["source_id"]) + "/"
            for item in [original["entry"]["body"]] + original["entry"].get("companions", []):
                native_name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
                retain(prefix + native_name, {"path": item["object"], "bytes": item["bytes"],
                                              "sha256": item["sha256"]})
        for item in native_members:
            retain("run-rasters/" + _relative(item["path"]), item)
        reference, comparisons = _operands(binding, report)
        labels = {name: "Reference: " + reference["label"] + ". Comparison: " + comparisons[name]["label"]
                  for name in report["scenarios"]}
        figures = landcover_report_figures.prepare(directory, edition, report, labels, figure_implementation)
        for item in figures["files"]:
            name = _relative(item["path"])
            if name in members:
                raise ValueError("Land-cover figure collided with an original member")
            members[name] = item
        sections.append(["Saved geographic and numerical figures", [
            "The vector map retains the original reporting polygons. Numerical figures use the completed "
            "unique-union transition matrix and every reporting polygon on its selected common support. "
            "Full numerical values, unavailable quantities, original IDs and figure implementation are attached.",
            _links([("Complete land-cover figure specification", figures["figure_spec"]),
                    ("Every original figure quantity", "figures/landcover-figure-data.json")]),
        ]])
        recipe = {
            "schema": observed_context.SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "title": title,
            "origin": {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
                       "ledger_id": edition["id"], "signature": report["signature"],
                       "input_mode": binding["selection"].get("input_mode", "runs"),
                       "area_method": "fractional_polygon_overlap",
                       "area_basis": report["grid"]["area_basis"]},
            "inputs": [members[name] for name in sorted(members)], "sections": sections,
            "figure_spec": figures["figure_spec"], "figures": figures["figures"],
            "source_links": ["records/source-bindings.json", "ledger/input-bindings.json",
                             "ledger/edition.json", "ledger/results/ledger.json",
                             "ledger/landcover-report.zip", "ledger/results/report.html",
                             figures["figure_spec"], "figures/landcover-figure-data.json"],
        }
        # Check every link against the exact published inventory before import.
        for unused, blocks in sections:
            for block in blocks:
                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "links":
                    for link in block["items"]:
                        if link["path"] not in members:
                            raise ValueError("A land-cover report link names a missing original member")
        recipe_path = directory / "landcover-report.json"
        atomic_json(recipe_path, recipe, immutable=True)
        recipe_file = describe_file(directory, recipe_path)
        source_id = "landcover-ledger-" + key
        manifest = {
            "schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": title,
            "scope": "Completed original land-cover ledger as a retained scientific-report source",
            "entries": [{
                "id": source_id, "kind": "document", "role": observed_context.ROLE,
                "title": title, "uri": "workspace://" + str(workspace.project["id"]) + "/landcover-ledgers/" + edition["id"],
                "vintage": str(report["completed_at"]), **recipe_file,
                "companions": [members[name] for name in sorted(members)],
                "metadata": {"origin": recipe["origin"], "source_kind": "saved_landcover_ledger",
                             "original_output_scope": "Original fractional polygon overlap and selected common raster support"},
            }],
        }
        manifest_path = directory / "sources.json"
        atomic_json(manifest_path, manifest, immutable=True)
        manifest_file = describe_file(directory, manifest_path)
        bundle = directory / "landcover-report-source.zip"
        _write_bundle(directory, {**members, recipe_file["path"]: recipe_file,
                                  manifest_file["path"]: manifest_file}, bundle)
        collection = workspace.import_sources(manifest_path)
        choice = {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id}
        bound = observed_context.bind(workspace, {"source_roles": {observed_context.ROLE: choice}})
        result = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "id": key, "state": "complete",
            "ledger_id": edition["id"], "title": title, "selection": identity,
            "source": choice, "observed_binding": bound, "created_at": now(),
            "files": {"recipe": describe_file(workspace.root, recipe_path),
                      "manifest": describe_file(workspace.root, manifest_path),
                      "source_bundle": describe_file(workspace.root, bundle)},
            "members": {name: describe_file(workspace.root, directory / name)
                        for name in sorted(members)},
        }
        _verify_source(workspace, result)
        atomic_json(receipt, result, immutable=True)
        return result

"""Editable original land-cover ledgers behind selected scientific reports.

This joins the maintained Study closure through raw CAS records. It does not
materialize source views, open raster datasets, render reports or run a reducer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier

SOURCE_SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-report-source/v1"
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
EDITION_SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-edition/v1"
SOURCE_BINDING = "upstate.landcover-source-binding/v1"
RUN_BINDING = "upstate.landcover-binding/v1"
REPORT_ROOT = "landcover-report-sources"
LEDGER_ROOT = "landcover-ledgers"


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source needs canonical relative member paths")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in item for item in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source member escapes its original directory")
    return value


def _same_file(first, second):
    return all(first.get(field) == second.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _body(closure, descriptor):
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    return closure.read(descriptor["object"])


def _timeline_references(selection, binding, report):
    """Bind explicit chronology to retained source records without a raster import."""
    annual = selection.get("annual_sources")
    if (not isinstance(annual, list) or len(annual) < 2
            or any(not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {
                "year", "source_collection_id", "source_id", "band"} for item in annual)):
        raise ValueError("Timeline Study needs every original year, source and band")
    years = [item["year"] for item in annual]
    if (any(type(year) is not int or not 1 <= year <= 9999 for year in years)
            or any(first >= second for first, second in zip(years, years[1:]))):
        raise ValueError("Timeline Study changed its explicit observation chronology")
    references = []
    for item in annual:
        choice = {key: value for key, value in item.items() if key != "year"}
        identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
        if (not isinstance(choice["source_id"], str) or not choice["source_id"].strip()
                or type(choice["band"]) is not int or choice["band"] < 1):
            raise ValueError("Timeline Study changed an original source or band")
        references.append(choice)
    if len({digest(choice) for choice in references}) != len(references):
        raise ValueError("Timeline Study repeats an original source band")
    timeline = report.get("timeline")
    if (not isinstance(timeline, dict)
            or timeline.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-timeline/v1"
            or timeline.get("years") != years
            or report.get("options", {}).get("support_scope") != "all"
            or selection.get("options", {}).get("support_scope", "all") != "all"):
        raise ValueError("Timeline Study lost its complete common-support chronology")
    identifier(binding.get("temporal_reducer_sha256"))
    return references


def _captured(closure, entry):
    recipe = _body(closure, entry["body"])
    metadata = entry["metadata"]
    origin = recipe.get("origin")
    if not isinstance(origin, dict) or origin.get("schema") != SOURCE_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover report lost its original producer identity")
    source_id = identifier(origin.get("id"))
    ledger_id = identifier(origin.get("ledger_id"))
    project_id = origin.get("project_id")
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
            or recipe.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA or metadata.get("origin") != origin
            or not isinstance(project_id, str) or not project_id
            or entry.get("id") != "landcover-ledger-" + source_id
            or entry.get("uri") != "workspace://" + project_id + "/landcover-ledgers/" + ledger_id):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover report source differs from its original producer")
    members = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source repeats an original companion")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    selected = set()
    requested = recipe.get("inputs")
    if not isinstance(requested, list) or not requested:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source must retain its original inputs")
    for item in requested:
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if name in selected or name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an exact original input: " + name)
        selected.add(name)
    if selected != set(members):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source companion inventory differs from its recipe")

    def original(name):
        if name not in members:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks original member: " + name)
        return _body(closure, members[name])

    edition = original("ledger/edition.json")
    binding = original("ledger/input-bindings.json")
    report = original("ledger/results/ledger.json")
    originals = original("records/source-bindings.json")
    if (edition.get("schema") != EDITION_SCHEMA or edition.get("id") != ledger_id
            or edition.get("workspace_id") != project_id or edition.get("state") != "complete"
            or binding.get("workspace_id") != project_id or digest(binding) != ledger_id
            or edition.get("binding_sha256") != ledger_id
            or edition.get("selection") != binding.get("selection")
            or edition.get("grid_id") != binding.get("grid_id")
            or edition.get("signature") != origin.get("signature")
            or report.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-ledger/1"
            or report.get("signature") != origin.get("signature") or report.get("complete") is not True
            or originals.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-report-originals/v1"
            or originals.get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or origin.get("area_method") != "fractional_polygon_overlap"
            or origin.get("area_basis") != report.get("grid", {}).get("area_basis")):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its saved ledger or original binding")
    selection = binding["selection"]
    source_mode = selection.get("input_mode") in ("sources", "timeline")
    if (binding.get("schema") != (SOURCE_BINDING if source_mode else RUN_BINDING)
            or origin.get("input_mode") != selection.get("input_mode", "runs")):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original operand mode")
    if source_mode and (binding.get("grid_id") is not None
                        or original("ledger/results/input-editions.json") != binding):
        raise ValueError("Annual-source ledger lost its exact portable source binding")
    files = edition.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, dict) or not files:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks its completed original artifacts")
    for item in files.values():
        name = "ledger/" + _relative(item["path"])
        if name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an original ledger artifact: " + name)
    for role, path in (("binding", "input-bindings.json"), ("ledger.json", "results/ledger.json"),
                       ("original_zones", "zones-original.geojson")):
        if files.get(role, {}).get("path") != path:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed an original artifact role")
    operands = binding.get("operands")
    if not isinstance(operands, list) or len(operands) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source needs its ordered baseline and alternatives")
    if edition.get("alternative_count") != len(operands) - 1:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original alternative count")
    if not source_mode and [row.get("run_id") for row in operands] != [
            selection.get("baseline_run_id"), *selection.get("alternative_run_ids", [])]:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its ordered native runs")
    if source_mode:
        if selection.get("input_mode") == "timeline":
            references = _timeline_references(selection, binding, report)
        else:
            references = [selection.get("baseline_source"), *selection.get("alternative_sources", [])]
        if [row.get("source_selection") for row in operands] != references:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its ordered raster sources or bands")
        keys = ["source-" + digest(choice)[:20] for choice in references[1:]]
    else:
        keys = [row["run_id"] for row in operands[1:]]
    if report.get("scenarios") != keys:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original computed alternative order")
    return origin, recipe, members, edition, binding, report, originals


def _original_entries(closure, binding, originals, members, *, local):
    requested = [(binding["zones"]["selection"], binding["zones"]["source_entry"])]
    if binding["schema"] == SOURCE_BINDING:
        requested.extend((row["source_selection"], row["source_entry"]) for row in binding["operands"])
    expected = {}
    for choice, entry in requested:
        collection_id = identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
        key = (collection_id, choice["source_id"])
        if key in expected and expected[key] != entry:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover operands disagree about an original source entry")
        expected[key] = entry
    captured = {}
    for row in originals.get("sources", []):
        key = (identifier(row["source_collection_id"]), row["source_id"])
        if key in captured or expected.get(key) != row.get("entry"):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original source roster")
        captured[key] = row["entry"]
        prefix = "originals/" + key[0] + "/" + digest(key[1]) + "/"
        for item in [row["entry"]["body"], *row["entry"].get("companions", [])]:
            name = prefix + _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
            if name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
                raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an original source body: " + name)
        if local:
            collection = closure.read("sources/" + key[0] + ".json")
            entries = [entry for entry in collection.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id") == key[1]]
            if (collection.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(collection) != key[0]
                    or entries != [row["entry"]]):
                raise ValueError("Editable land-cover input differs from its captured source")
            closure.need("sources", key[0], "Original land-cover raster or reporting source")
    if set(captured) != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source omitted an original input edition")
    return [{"kind": "sources", "id": key} for key in sorted({pair[0] for pair in expected})]


def _native_members(closure, binding, report, originals, members, *, local):
    native = originals.get("native_raster_members")
    if not isinstance(native, list):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks its native dependency inventory")
    if binding["schema"] == SOURCE_BINDING:
        if native:
            raise ValueError("Annual-source ledger unexpectedly declares native run members")
        return []
    accepted = {(item["bytes"], item["sha256"]) for item in report["inputs"]
                if item["role"] == "baseline" or item["role"].startswith("scenario:")
                or item["role"] == "raster-companion"}
    paths = {}
    for item in native:
        path = _relative(item["path"])
        if (path in paths or (item["bytes"], item["sha256"]) not in accepted
                or "run-rasters/" + path not in members
                or not _same_file(item, members["run-rasters/" + path])):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover native raster differs from its computed input")
        paths[path] = item
        if local:
            closure.add_file(path, item)
    for operand in binding["operands"]:
        raster = operand["raster"]
        if raster["path"] not in paths or not _same_file(paths[raster["path"]], raster):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost a native baseline or alternative raster")
    if not local:
        return []
    grid_id = identifier(binding["grid_id"])
    grid = closure.read("grids/" + grid_id + "/grid.json")
    if (grid.get("id") != grid_id or grid.get("grid") != binding["grid_definition"]
            or grid.get("spec") != binding["grid_spec"]):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover prepared grid differs from its binding")
    closure.need("grids", grid_id, "Original prepared grid for retained land-cover ledger")
    required = [{"kind": "grids", "id": grid_id}]
    for operand in binding["operands"]:
        run_id = identifier(operand["run_id"])
        run = closure.read("runs/" + run_id + "/run.json")
        if (run.get("id") != run_id or run.get("selection") != operand["selection"]
                or digest(run["selection"]) != run_id
                or run["selection"].get("grid_id") != grid_id):
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover run differs from its captured selection")
        scenario_id = identifier(run["selection"]["scenario_id"])
        scenario = closure.read("scenarios/" + scenario_id + ".json")
        if digest(scenario) != scenario_id or {**scenario, "id": scenario_id} != operand["scenario"]:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover scenario differs from its captured edition")
        if operand["basis"] == "retained_landcover_stage":
            descriptor = run.get("stages", {}).get("landcover", {}).get("artifact")
            if not isinstance(descriptor, dict):
                raise ValueError("Original land-cover stage artifact is missing")
            current = {**descriptor, "path": "runs/" + run_id + "/" + _relative(descriptor["path"])}
        elif operand["basis"] == "retained_grid_NLCD":
            descriptor = grid["files"]["NLCD"]
            current = {**descriptor, "path": "grids/" + grid_id + "/" + _relative(descriptor["path"])}
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unknown original land-cover raster basis")
        if current != operand["raster"]:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover raster descriptor changed")
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original selected run for saved land-cover ledger")
        required.append({"kind": "runs", "id": run_id})
    return required


def _local(closure, collection_id, entry, origin, recipe, members, edition, binding):
    key, ledger_id = origin["id"], origin["ledger_id"]
    prefix = REPORT_ROOT + "/" + key + "/"
    receipt = closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
    if (receipt.get("schema") != SOURCE_SCHEMA or receipt.get("state") != "complete"
            or receipt.get("id") != key or digest(receipt.get("selection")) != key
            or receipt["selection"].get("project_id") != origin["project_id"]
            or receipt.get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or receipt["selection"].get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or receipt["selection"].get("signature") != origin["signature"]
            or receipt.get("title") != recipe.get("title")):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report receipt differs from its source")
    source = receipt["source"]
    original_collection_id = identifier(source["source_collection_id"])
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + original_collection_id + ".json")
    original = [row for row in collection.get("entries", []) if row.get("id") == source.get("source_id")]
    if (digest(collection) != original_collection_id or len(original) != 1
            or source.get("source_id") != entry["id"]
            or not _same_file(original[0]["body"], entry["body"])):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report lost its original imported source")
    original_members = {}
    for item in original[0].get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in original_members:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report repeats a source companion")
        original_members[name] = item
    if (set(original_members) != set(members)
            or any(not _same_file(original_members[name], item) for name, item in members.items())):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report lost its original imported source")
    closure.need("sources", original_collection_id, "Original imported land-cover report source")
    retained = receipt.get("members")
    if not isinstance(retained, dict) or set(retained) != set(members):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover source changed its member roster")
    for name, descriptor in retained.items():
        if descriptor.get("path") != prefix + name or not _same_file(descriptor, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover source changed an original member")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    for descriptor in receipt["files"].values():
        path = _relative(descriptor["path"])
        if not path.startswith(prefix):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover report file belongs to another original source")
        closure.add_file(path, descriptor)
    if (receipt["files"]["recipe"]["path"] != prefix + "landcover-report.json"
            or not _same_file(receipt["files"]["recipe"], entry["body"])
            or closure.read(prefix + "landcover-report.json") != recipe):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report recipe differs from its source")
    ledger_prefix = LEDGER_ROOT + "/" + ledger_id + "/"
    for name, expected in (("edition.json", edition), ("input-bindings.json", binding)):
        closure.add_file(ledger_prefix + name, members["ledger/" + name])
        if closure.read(ledger_prefix + name) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover ledger changed its original " + name)
    for descriptor in edition["files"].values():
        closure.add_file(ledger_prefix + _relative(descriptor["path"]), descriptor)
    # Capture the original completed reducer database/checkpoints as well as every
    # declared report artifact. The maintained closure detects concurrent changes.
    closure.tree(ledger_prefix.rstrip("/"))
    closure.tree(prefix.rstrip("/"))
    return original_collection_id


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Follow this producer only for an explicitly ordered saved-report source."""
    source_kind = (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("source_kind")
    if source_kind == "observed-landcover-selections":
        from . import observed_landcover_study_transfer
        return observed_landcover_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    if source_kind != "saved_landcover_ledger":
        return False
    identifier(collection_id)
    origin, recipe, members, edition, binding, report, originals = _captured(closure, entry)
    local = origin["project_id"] == closure.workspace.project["id"]
    required = _original_entries(closure, binding, originals, members, local=local)
    native_required = _native_members(closure, binding, report, originals, members, local=local)
    if local:
        original_source_id = _local(closure, collection_id, entry, origin, recipe, members, edition, binding)
        required.extend(native_required)
        if {"kind": "sources", "id": original_source_id} not in required:
            required.append({"kind": "sources", "id": original_source_id})
    record = {
        "schema": "upstate.study-report-lineage/v1",
        "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
        "source_body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        "source_project_id": origin["project_id"],
        "report_context_kind": "landcover_ledger", "landcover_ledger_id": origin["ledger_id"],
        "landcover_report_source_id": origin["id"], "producer_edition": recipe["edition"],
        "signature": origin["signature"], "selection": deepcopy(binding["selection"]),
        "input_mode": origin["input_mode"], "area_method": origin["area_method"],
        "area_basis": origin["area_basis"],
        "relationship": "same_project" if local else "external_project",
        "required_records": required if local else [],
        "source_entries": [{"source_collection_id": row["source_collection_id"],
                            "source_id": row["source_id"], "body_sha256": row["entry"]["body"]["sha256"]}
                           for row in originals["sources"]],
        "original_members": {name: members[name]["sha256"] for name in sorted(members)},
    }
    token = (collection_id, entry["id"])
    previous = closure.report_source_records.get(token)
    if previous is not None and previous != record:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source lineage changed during Study selection")
    closure.report_source_records[token] = record
    return True

# Observed land-cover trajectories

This extension operates inside the existing Land-cover changes calculation, saved Workspace editions, Scientific Reports and portable exports. The original pairwise run/source behavior is retained. Select **Observed timeline** in the existing operator; select actual retained raster bands, enter their observation years in chronological order, choose the original reporting polygons and inspect the input preview before running. The ordinary operator handles these controls; a JSON selection is an optional scriptable representation.

## Source and scientific meaning

Use the actual source's mapping year, not its download date. The input preview displays the original label, vintage, URI, band and exact raster identity. Years are explicit operator selections bound into the saved calculation; they are not inferred from filenames. Keep the product and collection/version consistent and retain all original masks/sidecars. The application requires an identical native width, height, coordinate system and affine transform across the observations and does not resample categorical rasters in this operation.

USGS Annual NLCD Collection 1.2 includes observations through2025. Its official change product is derived from differences between consecutive land-cover maps, attributed to the later observation year. The class maps and confidence product have different roles: classification confidence is not a probability that an inferred real-world management event occurred. The core original source references are:

- USGS, Annual NLCD Collection 1.2 release: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/news/annual-nlcd-collection-12-now-available
- USGS, Annual NLCD Land Cover Change: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/usgs-eros-archive-land-cover-annual-nlcd-collection-1-land-cover-change
- USGS, Annual NLCD Land Cover Confidence: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/usgs-eros-archive-land-cover-annual-nlcd-collection-12-land-cover-confidence
- MRLC, actual class legend: https://www.mrlc.gov/data/legends/annual-nlcd-land-cover-legend
- USGS original data release: https://doi.org/10.5066/P94UXNTS

These primary sources were read on 2026-10-13. Product availability is context; each calculation remains bound to the source bytes actually selected in its Workspace.

A sequence such as 41 →21 →41 contains two observed transitions and a return to its initial class. It must not disappear merely because its endpoint classes agree. A sequence 41 →42 →43 changes the detailed forest class while remaining within the original41/42/43 forest group. Woody wetland 90 remains in the original wetland group. Other class groups are unchanged from the maintained reducer.

**Observed retention:** persistent final area is changed area whose final class appears in at least two trailing selected observations. It is not continuous duration, a verified event date, ecological recovery or future permanence. The last transition is bracketed by its two selected years. For 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, the 2020→2022 interval remains a two-calendar-year gap. No 2021 class is created. Two observations alone support an endpoint change; they cannot show a return or repeated final-state evidence after a change.

**Returns and groups:** reversal_count counts each transition into a class previously observed after leaving it. Thus 41→21→42→21 has one such return even though it ends in a different class from the initial one. returned_to_initial reports the separate whole-sequence endpoint return. Group entered/exited hectares each count a cell once if any corresponding group crossing occurred. A forest→nonforest→forest path contributes to both entry and exit and to returned membership. Those quantities overlap and must not be summed as disjoint areas.

## Calculation and interruption recovery

The original reducer reads each native window once. It computes the existing exact polygon/pixel intersection fractions, original valid masks and supported class codes, and uses the intersection across **all** selected observations. Pair-specific masks are refused for a timeline. Unknown codes follow the existing error/exclude policy, and original support/unknown-class accounts remain in the baseline-versus-each-observation rows.

The same window's exact class-sequence patterns and fractional hectares are attached to the existing original SQLite tile transaction. The original raster outputs and every temporal output close before committing that row. A cancelled or interrupted tile is rewritten on resume; a committed tile is reused. The fingerprint includes original source and companion hashes, ordered bands, selected years, options and the temporal reducer source identity. Changed inputs or chronology require a new edition. There is no second scheduler, checkpoint store or hydrology model.

Every annual class table, adjacent transition matrix and trajectory total uses the same support. The complete trajectory total is checked against the original ledger's common-support area. Each reporting polygon retains fractional hectares; the study-area domain is the unique union. Positive-area cell-intersection counts are useful local counts but double-count a boundary cell across adjoining polygons, so sum hectares instead.

## Full outputs and normal reopening

Existing ledger.json, report.html, original comparison CSVs, source-edition binding, polygon geometry and baseline transition rasters remain present. The same portable archive additionally contains:

| File | Meaning |
|---|---|
| timeline-summary.csv | Every reporting area's observed change, returns, retained final class and forest quantities |
| timeline-trajectories.csv | Every actual selected class sequence, area, intersection count and observation metrics |
| timeline-annual-classes.csv | Every class area in every selected observation |
| timeline-adjacent-transitions.csv | Every adjacent selected-observation transition |
| timeline-groups.csv | Stable membership and overlapping observed group-crossing accounts |
| timeline-source-years.csv | Explicit observation years beside original source vintage, band and identity |
| timeline-class-sequence.tif | One native-grid band per selected year; original class codes, zero excluded |
| timeline-status.tif | 1 stable, 2 one transition, 3 multiple transitions, 4 returned to initial; 0 excluded |
| timeline-change-count-plus-one.tif | Observed transition count plus 1; 0 excluded |
| timeline-final-class-observations.tif | Trailing selected observations in final class; 0 excluded |
| timeline-last-transition-to-year.tif | Later selected year in last transition; 0 stable or excluded, distinguished using status |
| timeline-forest-status.tif | 1 always forest, 2 always outside, 3 ended in forest after entry, 4 ended outside after exit, 5 returned membership; 0 excluded |

Raster class attribution stays at the original pixel resolution; apply study-area-fraction.tif to obtain the unique study-area fraction. The exact original polygons and full source-year table remain in the archive. The source inputs themselves remain retained in Workspace; **Prepare scientific report** also carries those actual original inputs through the existing source bundle.

Open the existing report.html to view the full annual tables, paginate all trajectories, inspect adjacent matrices and download the original CSV/raster files. Open the whole archive with the original landcover receive command to verify every declared member. A saved timeline appears in the existing edition list and is inspected by the original Workspace reader. Scientific Reports receives the complete chronology and per-area summary, annual class table, source identities and every original attached output.

## Optional native API

Use the existing model.landcover_cli workspace preview/build commands with the same ordinary selection path. A selection's additional fields are:

    {
      "input_mode": "timeline",
      "annual_sources": [
        {"year": 2021, "source_collection_id": "<actual existing ID>", "source_id": "<actual raster ID>", "band": 1},

      "options": {"support_scope": "all", "unknown_policy": "error"},
      "title": "Observed land-cover timeline"
    }

The template IDs are placeholders, never sample project identifiers. The UI supplies actual catalogue selections and preserves the original source labels. Years must be unique integers 1–9999 in strictly increasing order. A source band may be selected only once. Existing source/run selectors keep their original shapes and behavior.

Apply CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md 2026-10-13.4 together with the newer full post-call 52-order bank F0C8R2SQ0NP in the original Eco thread.         [41, 52, 71, 82], [41, 0, 21, 21], [90, 41, 90, 41], [41, 99, 41, 41], [11, 11, 11, 11],
    ]
    entries = []
    for index, year in enumerate(observations):
        path = source / (str(year) + ".tif")
        values = np.array([row[index] for row in patterns], dtype=np.uint8).reshape(2, 5)
        with rasterio.open(path, "w", driver="GTiff", height=2, width=5, count=1,
                           dtype="uint8", crs="EPSG:5070", transform=from_origin(0, 200, 100, 100), nodata=0) as target:
            target.write(values, 1)
            target.set_band_description(1, "Explicit authored " + str(year) + " teaching classes")
        entries.append({"id": "teaching-" + str(year), "kind": "raster", "role": "NLCD",
                        "title": "Authored native trajectory " + str(year), "vintage": str(year),
                        "uri": "authored://landcover-timeline/" + str(year),
                        **describe_file(source, path)})
    features = []
    for code, name, low, high in [("001", "Western fractional area", 25, 250),
                                 ("002", "Eastern fractional area", 250, 475)]:
        features.append({"type": "Feature", "properties": {"huc12": code, "name": name},
                         "geometry": {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[low, 0], [high, 0],
                                      [high, 200], [low, 200], [low, 0]]]}})
    atomic_json(source / "areas.geojson", {"type": "FeatureCollection",
                "crs": {"type": "name", "properties": {"name": "EPSG:5070"}}, "features": features})
    entries.append({"id": "teaching-areas", "kind": "vector", "role": "reporting",
                    "title": "Authored fractional reporting polygons", "vintage": "2026-10-13",
                    "uri": "authored://landcover-timeline/reporting", **describe_file(source, source / "areas.geojson")})
    atomic_json(source / "sources.json", {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": "Authored land-cover trajectory course",
                                         "scope": "Explicit native teaching inputs, not regional observations", "entries": entries})
    workspace = Workspace(root / "teaching-workspace", create=True, title="Observed land-cover native teaching course")
    collection = workspace.import_sources(source / "sources.json")
    selection = {
        "input_mode": "timeline", "title": "Authored observed trajectory receiving",
        "annual_sources": [{"year": year, "source_collection_id": collection["id"],
                            "source_id": "teaching-" + str(year), "band": 1} for year in observations],
        "zones": {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": "teaching-areas",
                  "id_field": "huc12", "name_field": "name"},
        "options": {"tile_size": 2, "support_scope": "all", "unknown_policy": "exclude"},
    }
    atomic_json(root / "selected-inputs.json", selection)
    return workspace, selection


def operate(output, *, workspace_path=None, selection_path=None):
    output = Path(output).expanduser().resolve()
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("Choose a new receiving output directory")
    if workspace_path is not None:
        original = Path(workspace_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
        if output.is_relative_to(original) or original.is_relative_to(output):
            raise ValueError("Retain original Workspace and receiving output in separate directories")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    if workspace_path is None:
        workspace, selection = _original_example(output)
        authored = True
    else:
        workspace, selection = Workspace(workspace_path), read_json(selection_path)
        authored = False
        atomic_json(output / "selected-inputs.json", selection)
    if selection.get("input_mode") != "timeline":
        raise LedgerError("Select the complete original timeline")
    preview = landcover_workspace.preview_inputs(workspace, selection)
    atomic_json(output / "input-preview.json", preview)
    progress_rows = []
    interrupted = False
    if authored:
        def interrupt_after_original_commit(status):
            progress_rows.append(dict(status))
            if status["completed_tiles"] == 1:
                raise InterruptedError("Authored operator cancellation after the first committed native tile")
        try:
            landcover_workspace.build(workspace, selection, progress=interrupt_after_original_commit)
        except InterruptedError:
            interrupted = True
        if not interrupted:
            raise RuntimeError("The original tile cancellation was not reached")
    edition = landcover_workspace.build(workspace, selection, progress=lambda row: progress_rows.append(dict(row)))
    retained = landcover_workspace.inspect(workspace, edition["id"])
    report = retained["report"]
    directory = workspace.root / landcover_workspace.KIND / edition["id"]
    archive = verify_file(directory, edition["files"]["archive"])
    received = receive_portable(archive, output / "received-report")
    if read_json(Path(received["path"]) / "ledger.json") != report:
        raise RuntimeError("The complete received report changed")
    # Cold Workspace and original reader reopen the same source-bound edition.
    cold = landcover_workspace.inspect(Workspace(workspace.root), edition["id"])
    if cold != retained or landcover_workspace.build(workspace, selection) != edition:
        raise RuntimeError("Original saved-edition reopen/reuse changed")
    csv_counts = {}
    for name in ("timeline-summary.csv", "timeline-trajectories.csv", "timeline-annual-classes.csv",
                 "timeline-adjacent-transitions.csv", "timeline-groups.csv", "timeline-source-years.csv"):
        with (Path(received["path"]) / name).open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
            csv_counts[name] = sum(1 for row in csv.DictReader(stream))
    if authored:
        domain = next(row for row in report["timeline"]["rows"] if row["zone_id"] == "__domain__")
        expected = {"stable_ha": 1.5, "changed_ha": 5.5, "one_observed_transition_ha": 1.75,
                    "multiple_observed_transitions_ha": 3.75, "returned_to_initial_ha": 1.0,
                    "changed_without_return_ha": 4.5, "persistent_final_ha": 3.75,
                    "unconfirmed_final_ha": 1.75, "forest_internal_only_ha": 1.0,
                    "forest_exit_ha": 3.75, "forest_entry_ha": 2.75}
        import math
        if not math.isclose(domain["analysis_ha"], 7.0, abs_tol=1e-9) or not math.isclose(domain["covered_ha"], 9.0, abs_tol=1e-9):
            raise RuntimeError("Fractional native support changed")
        for key, value in expected.items():
            if not math.isclose(domain["summary"][key], value, abs_tol=1e-9):
                raise RuntimeError("Observed trajectory quantity differs: " + key)
        if [row["completed_tiles"] for row in progress_rows] != [1, 2, 3]:
            raise RuntimeError("A completed native tile was repeated during continuation")
        if report["timeline"]["intervals"][1]["gap_years"] != 2:
            raise RuntimeError("The original missing observation year was interpolated")
        inputs = landcover_workspace._inputs(workspace, selection)
        zones = directory / "zones-original.geojson"
        legacy = run_ledger(inputs["rasters"][0], dict(zip(inputs["keys"], inputs["rasters"][1:])),
                            zones, output / "original-pairwise", options=Options(**selection["options"], title=selection["title"]),
                            id_field="_landcover_zone_id", name_field="_landcover_zone_name")
        if legacy["rows"] != report["rows"] or legacy["zones"] != report["zones"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Original pairwise quantities changed")
        for invalid in ({**selection, "annual_sources": list(reversed(selection["annual_sources"]))},
                        {**selection, "options": {**selection["options"], "support_scope": "pair"}}):
            try:
                landcover_workspace.preview_inputs(workspace, invalid)
            except LedgerError:
                pass
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("An invalid chronology/support selection was accepted")
    import rasterio
    with rasterio.open(Path(received["path"]) / report["rasters"]["timeline"]["sequence"]) as sequence:
        if sequence.count != len(report["timeline"]["years"]):
            raise RuntimeError("The complete original sequence raster lost observations")
        sequence_bands = list(sequence.descriptions)
    from .landcover_report_source import _original_sources, _sections
    sections = _sections(edition, retained["binding"], report, _original_sources(workspace, retained["binding"]))
    atomic_json(output / "scientific-report-sections.json", sections)
    result = {"schema": "upstate.landcover-timeline-receiving/v1", "state": "complete",
              "input_kind": "explicit_authored_native_teaching_case" if authored else "existing_original_workspace_selection",
              "workspace": str(workspace.root), "edition_id": edition["id"], "signature": report["signature"],
              "observation_years": report["timeline"]["years"], "reporting_rows": len(report["timeline"]["rows"]),
              "interrupted_after_original_commit": interrupted, "actual_progress": progress_rows,
              "csv_rows": csv_counts, "sequence_band_descriptions": sequence_bands,
              "source_edition_reopened": True, "portable_report": received,
              "scientific_report_sections": len(sections)}
    atomic_json(output / "receiving.json", result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if bool(args.workspace) != bool(args.selection):
        parser.error("Supply the existing Workspace and its original selection together")
    print(json.dumps(operate(args.output, workspace_path=args.workspace, selection_path=args.selection), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Receive one existing completed observed timeline through the original Study path.

This is an operating continuation, not a numerical experiment. It prepares the
original Scientific Reports source, exports the selected editable Study, restores
it with model.portable and reopens it in a separate process using the copied app.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal

from .common import atomic_json, digest, file_digest, held, identifier, now, read_json, verify_file

SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-timeline-study-receiving/v1"
IMPLEMENTATION = (
    "model/landcover_timeline_study_receiving.py",
    "model/landcover_study_transfer.py",
    "model/landcover_report_source.py",
    "model/scientific_report_editions.py",
    "model/study_transfer.py",
    "model/portable.py",
)


def _regular(path):
    path = Path(path)
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Keep original receiving members as ordinary files: " + str(path))
    return path


def _pin(path):
    path = _regular(path)
    return {"bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(path)}


def _tree(root):
    """Stream every original file; preserve original names and complete membership."""
    root = Path(root)
    if root.is_symlink() or not root.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("Original artifact directory is absent or linked: " + str(root))
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Original artifact tree contains a linked member: " + str(path))
        if path.is_file():
            result[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = _pin(path)
        elif not path.is_dir():
            raise ValueError("Original artifact tree contains a non-file member: " + str(path))
    return result


def _same(actual, expected, message):
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _write(path, value):
    atomic_json(Path(path), value)


def _keep(path, value):
    if path.exists():
        _same(read_json(_regular(path)), value, "Saved receiving stage differs: " + path.name)
    else:
        atomic_json(path, value, immutable=True)
    return value


def _implementation(application):
    return {name: _pin(application / name) for name in IMPLEMENTATION}


def _snapshot(workspace, ledger_id):
    state = landcover_workspace.inspect(workspace, ledger_id)
    edition, binding, report = state["edition"], state["binding"], state["report"]
    selection = binding["selection"]
    if (edition.get("state") != "complete" or report.get("complete") is not True
            or selection.get("input_mode") != "timeline"
            or report.get("timeline", {}).get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-timeline/v1"
            or report.get("options", {}).get("support_scope") != "all"):
        raise ValueError("Select the original existing completed all-observation timeline ledger")
    years = [row["year"] for row in selection["annual_sources"]]
    _same(report["timeline"]["years"], years, "Original selected years changed")
    directory = workspace.root / landcover_workspace.KIND / ledger_id
    # This full tree includes the retained reducer checkpoint and every output.
    # It is never modified or regenerated by this course.
    return {"project": deepcopy(workspace.project), "ledger_id": ledger_id,
            "state": deepcopy(state), "ledger_files": _tree(directory),
            "years": years}


def _source_files(workspace, source):
    expected = {}
    for item in [*source["files"].values(), *source["members"].values()]:
        path = verify_file(workspace.root, item)
        relative = path.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()
        value = {"bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
        if relative in expected and expected[relative] != value:
            raise ValueError("Original source file identities collide")
        expected[relative] = value
    return expected


def _report_files(workspace, report_id):
    record, directory, operation = scientific_report_editions.inspect(workspace, report_id)
    members = scientific_report_editions.files(record, directory)
    return {
        "record": record, "operation": operation,
        "files": {name: {**descriptor, "workspace_path": (directory / descriptor["path"]).relative_to(
            workspace.root).as_posix()} for name, descriptor in members.items()},
    }


def _verify_files(root, expected):
    for relative, wanted in expected.items():
        path = Path(root) / relative
        if path.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(root).resolve()) is False:
            raise ValueError("Original receiving path escapes its selected root")
        _same(_pin(path), wanted, "Original received member changed: " + relative)


def _selected_ledger_files(manifest, original):
    """Bind cold ledger membership to the original portable archive selection."""
    prefix = "workspace/" + landcover_workspace.KIND + "/" + original["ledger_id"] + "/"
    selected = {}
    for name, descriptor in manifest["members"].items():
        if name.startswith(prefix):
            relative = name[len(prefix):]
            portable.member_name(relative)
            expected = {key: descriptor[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")}
            _same(original["ledger_files"].get(relative), expected,
                  "Study ledger member differs from its original snapshot: " + relative)
            selected[relative] = expected
    if not selected:
        raise ValueError("Study omitted the selected original ledger")
    excluded = {}
    for relative, descriptor in original["ledger_files"].items():
        if relative in selected:
            continue
        path = Path(relative)
        reason = None
        if path.name.endswith((".lock", ".pyc", ".pyo")):
            reason = "Original portable lock/compiled-runtime exclusion"
        elif path.name.startswith((".write-", ".intake-", ".archive-",
                                   ".native-reserve-", ".native-recovery-reserve")):
            reason = "Original portable transient-file exclusion"
        else:
            for index, part in enumerate(path.parts[:-1]):
                parent = Path(*path.parts[:index + 1])
                if (part in portable.RUNTIME_DIRECTORIES or part == "source-views"
                        or part.startswith((".archive-", ".receive-", ".write-", ".intake-"))
                        or (parent / "pyvenv.cfg").as_posix() in original["ledger_files"]):
                    reason = "Original portable runtime/materialized-view directory exclusion"
                    break
        if reason is None:
            raise ValueError("Study omitted an original scientific/checkpoint member: " + relative)
        excluded[relative] = {**descriptor, "reason": reason}
    return {"files": selected, "intentional_portable_exclusions": excluded}


def _cold_receive(spec_path, result_path):
    """Executed only by the copied application's module in a separate interpreter."""
    spec = read_json(_regular(spec_path))
    application = Path(spec["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    actual_application = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    _same(actual_application, application, "Cold receiving imported another application")
    for module in (landcover_workspace, landcover_report_source, scientific_report_editions, study_transfer, portable):
        if not Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(application):
            raise ValueError("Cold receiving imported a producer module outside the copied application")
    _verify_files(application, spec["application_files"])
    workspace = Workspace(spec["workspace"])
    original = spec["original"]
    current = _snapshot(workspace, original["ledger_id"])
    _same({key: value for key, value in current.items() if key != "ledger_files"},
          {key: value for key, value in original.items() if key != "ledger_files"},
          "Cold original ledger state/source/chronology differs")
    _same(current["ledger_files"], spec["ledger_selection"]["files"],
          "Cold ledger differs from the exact archive-selected original members")
    source = landcover_report_source.get(workspace, spec["source"]["id"])
    _same(source, spec["source"], "Cold report-source receipt differs")
    _verify_files(workspace.root, spec["source_files"])
    report = _report_files(workspace, spec["report_id"])
    _same(report, spec["report"], "Cold scientific report or complete attachments differ")
    for descriptor in report["files"].values():
        _same(_pin(workspace.root / descriptor["workspace_path"]),
              {key: descriptor[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")},
              "Cold report attachment differs")
    received = study_transfer.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    matched = [row for row in received if row.get("id") == spec["study_id"]]
    if len(matched) != 1 or matched[0].get("identity") != "MATCH":
        raise ValueError("Cold receiving did not reopen the exact selected editable Study")
    result = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "state": "complete", "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
        "ledger_id": original["ledger_id"], "years": original["years"],
        "signature": original["state"]["report"]["signature"],
        "scientific_report_edition_id": spec["report_id"], "study_id": spec["study_id"],
        "application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace.root),
        "application_files": len(spec["application_files"]),
        "original_ledger_files": len(original["ledger_files"]),
        "received_ledger_files": len(spec["ledger_selection"]["files"]),
        "intentional_portable_exclusions": spec["ledger_selection"]["intentional_portable_exclusions"],
        "source_files": len(spec["source_files"]), "report_files": report["files"],
        "received_study": matched[0], "original_ledger_unchanged": True,
        "numerical_run_started": False, "browser_started": False,
    }
    _write(result_path, result)
    return result


def run_existing(workspace_path, ledger_id, output, *, title=None, resume=False):
    """Operate one existing ledger; resume only this exact retained continuation."""
    application = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    workspace = Workspace(Path(workspace_path).resolve(strict=True))
    ledger_id = identifier(ledger_id)
    output = Path(output).absolute()
    if output.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Use an ordinary owned receiving output directory")
    # The entire receiving tree must remain outside both original source and data.
    resolved = output.resolve()
    for protected in (application, workspace.root):
        if resolved == protected or resolved.is_relative_to(protected) or protected.is_relative_to(resolved):
            raise ValueError("Receiving output must be separate from original application and Workspace")
    if output.exists():
        if not resume or not output.is_dir():
            raise ValueError("Use a new output directory, or --resume for this exact original course")
    else:
        if resume:
            raise ValueError("The original receiving output does not exist")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
        os.chmod(output, 0o700)
    request = {"application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace.root),
               "ledger_id": ledger_id, "title": title, "implementation": _implementation(application)}
    marker = output / "receiving-request.json"
    with held(output / ".receiving.lock", blocking=False):
        if resume:
            _same(read_json(_regular(marker)), request, "Resume selected another original request or implementation")
        else:
            atomic_json(marker, request, immutable=True)
        state = {"schema": SCHEMA, "state": "running", "request": request,
                 "output": str(output), "started_at": now(), "stages": []}
        state_path = output / "receiving.json"
        events_path = output / "events.jsonl"
        def event(stage, **detail):
            item = {"stage": stage, "at": now(), **detail}
            state["stages"].append(item)
            _write(state_path, state)
            with events_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                stream.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            print(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
        original = None
        child = None
        try:
            event("opening_original_ledger")
            original = _snapshot(workspace, ledger_id)
            _keep(output / "original-ledger.json", original)
            event("original_completed_ledger", ledger_id=ledger_id, years=original["years"],
                  signature=original["state"]["report"]["signature"])
            source_spec = {"ledger_id": ledger_id}
            if title is not None:
                source_spec["title"] = title
            event("preparing_original_report_source")
            source_result = landcover_report_source.prepare(workspace, source_spec)
            # prepare may annotate an existing receipt with reused:true; store
            # the immutable source receipt returned by its real get operation.
            source = landcover_report_source.get(workspace, source_result["id"])
            _keep(output / "original-report-source.json", source)
            source_files = _source_files(workspace, source)
            _keep(output / "original-source-files.json", source_files)
            preview_path = output / "original-report-preview.json"
            if preview_path.exists():
                preview = read_json(_regular(preview_path))
            else:
                preview = scientific_report_editions.preview(
                    workspace, {"sources": [source["source"]], "title": source["title"]})
                _keep(preview_path, preview)
            # Reconcile a completed original rendering before retrying its
            # original prepared effect. This uses the selected saved edition.
            report_id = identifier(preview["id"])
            _same(digest(preview["render_identity"]), report_id, "Original report preview identity differs")
            scientific_report_editions.validate_request(
                workspace, {"sources": [source["source"]], "title": source["title"]}, preview["render_identity"])
            if (scientific_report_editions.directory(workspace, report_id) / "edition.json").is_file():
                retained, unused_directory, unused_operation = scientific_report_editions.inspect(workspace, report_id)
                _same(retained["render_identity"], preview["render_identity"], "Completed report belongs to another retained preview")
                rendered = {"scientific_report_edition_id": report_id, "state": "complete"}
            else:
                event("rendering_original_scientific_report", preview_id=report_id)
                rendered = scientific_report_editions.render_prepared(workspace, preview)
            _same(rendered["scientific_report_edition_id"], report_id, "Report result changed the original preview")
            report = _report_files(workspace, report_id)
            _keep(output / "original-scientific-report.json", report)
            report_zip = scientific_report_editions.export(workspace, report_id)
            _keep(output / "original-report-export.json", report_zip)
            event("original_report_complete", scientific_report_edition_id=report_id,
                  files=len(report["files"]))
            selection = {"title": source["title"],
                         "roots": [{"kind": "scientific-report-editions", "id": report_id}],
                         "include_related_results": False}
            plan = study_transfer.preview(workspace, selection)
            _write(output / "study-preview.json", plan)
            selection["preview_token"] = plan["preview_token"]
            archive = output / "timeline-selected-study.zip"
            event("exporting_selected_study", roots=selection["roots"])
            transfer = study_transfer.export_study(
                workspace, archive, selection, progress=lambda detail: event("study_export", detail=detail))
            _write(output / "study-export.json", transfer)
            archive_identity = _pin(archive)
            _same(archive_identity, {key: transfer[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")},
                  "Selected Study archive differs from its native receipt")
            _keep(output / "study-archive-identity.json", archive_identity)
            inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(archive, verify=True)
            _same(inspected["study"], transfer["study"], "Selected Study receipt differs inside the archive")
            _same(inspected["study"]["identity"]["selection"], study_transfer.normalise(selection),
                  "Selected Study changed its original report root")
            _same(inspected["manifest"]["project"], workspace.project, "Study belongs to another original project")
            _keep(output / "study-inspection.json", inspected)
            ledger_selection = _selected_ledger_files(inspected["manifest"], original)
            _keep(output / "study-ledger-members.json", ledger_selection)
            application_files = {}
            for name, descriptor in inspected["manifest"]["members"].items():
                if name.startswith("application/"):
                    application_files[name[len("application/"):]] = {
                        key: descriptor[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")}
            if not application_files:
                raise ValueError("Selected Study does not contain the complete original application")
            for name in IMPLEMENTATION:
                _same(application_files.get(name), request["implementation"][name],
                      "Selected Study omitted or changed its receiving implementation: " + name)
            destination = output / "received"
            event("receiving_selected_study", destination=str(destination))
            if destination.exists():
                restored = portable.resume_restore(
                    archive, destination, expected_archive_sha256=archive_identity["sha256"])
            else:
                restored = portable.restore(archive, destination)
            _write(output / "original-restore.json", restored)
            _same(restored["archive_sha256"], archive_identity["sha256"], "Restore consumed another archive")
            _same(restored["identity"], "MATCH", "Restore did not return matched identity")
            copied = Path(restored["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
            received_workspace = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
            _same(copied, (destination / "application").resolve(), "Restore returned another application")
            _same(received_workspace, (destination / "workspace").resolve(), "Restore returned another Workspace")
            # Exercise the same native completed-receive reconciliation. Do not
            # manufacture an interruption or overwrite the published destination.
            reconciled = portable.resume_restore(
                archive, destination, expected_archive_sha256=archive_identity["sha256"])
            if not reconciled.get("reused_completed_output"):
                raise ValueError("Completed original receiving was not reconciled")
            _write(output / "original-restore-resumed.json", reconciled)
            spec = {
                "application": str(copied), "workspace": str(received_workspace),
                "application_files": application_files, "original": original,
                "ledger_selection": ledger_selection,
                "source": source, "source_files": source_files,
                "report_id": report_id, "report": report, "study_id": transfer["id"],
            }
            spec_path = output / "cold-receive-input.json"
            _keep(spec_path, spec)
            cold_path = output / "cold-receive-result.json"
            _verify_files(copied, application_files)
            bootstrap = (
                "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);"
                "from model.landcover_timeline_study_receiving import _cold_receive;"
                "_cold_receive(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3])")
            event("cold_reopening_copied_application", application=str(copied))
            with (output / "cold.stdout.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stdout, (
                    output / "cold.stderr.txt").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stderr:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [sys.executable, "-I", "-c", bootstrap, str(copied), str(spec_path), str(cold_path)],
                    cwd=copied, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
                try:
                    code = child.wait()
                except BaseException:
                    if child.poll() is None:
                        child.terminate()
                        try:
                            child.wait(timeout=10)
                        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                            child.kill(); child.wait()
                    raise
                finally:
                    child = None
            if code != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("Copied-application receiving returned " + str(code) + "; retain cold.stderr.txt")
            cold = read_json(_regular(cold_path))
            if cold.get("state") != "complete" or cold.get("study_id") != transfer["id"]:
                raise ValueError("Copied application did not finish the selected original Study")
            _same(_snapshot(workspace, ledger_id), original, "Producer ledger changed during report/Study receiving")
            _same(_pin(archive), archive_identity, "Original selected archive changed during receiving")
            state.update(
                state="complete", completed_at=now(), ledger_id=ledger_id,
                scientific_report_edition_id=report_id, study_id=transfer["id"],
                years=original["years"], archive={"path": str(archive), **archive_identity},
                receiving=restored, cold_receiving=cold,
                original_ledger_unchanged=True, numerical_run_started=False, browser_started=False,
                visual_inspection="Pending actual original operator/report and every outgoing attachment inspection by producing peer.")
            event("complete", ledger_id=ledger_id, study_id=transfer["id"], years=original["years"])
            return state
        except BaseException as error:
            state.update(state="interrupted" if isinstance(error, (KeyboardInterrupt, InterruptedError)) else "failed",
                         error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)},
                         failed_at=now())
            (output / "error.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            if original is not None:
                try:
                    state["original_ledger_unchanged"] = _snapshot(workspace, ledger_id) == original
                except BaseException as preservation_error:
                    state["preservation_error"] = str(preservation_error)
            event(state["state"], error=state["error"])
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="Original retained Workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", required=True, help="Existing completed observed timeline ledger ID")
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="New private output outside original app and Workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--title", help="Optional original scientific-report title")
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true", help="Continue this exact original saved request")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    def interrupted(signum, unused):
        raise InterruptedError("Original receiving interrupted by signal " + str(signum))
    prior = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    try:
        result = run_existing(args.workspace, args.ledger, args.out, title=args.title, resume=args.resume)
        print(json.dumps({"state": result["state"], "output": result["output"],
                          "study_id": result["study_id"], "archive": result["archive"]}), flush=True)
        return 0
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, prior)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
