"""Retain editable original selected-HUC comparisons in scientific Study exports.

The existing Study closure captures raw CAS bodies and exact saved records. This
adapter does not rebuild comparisons, render figures, or open raster datasets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier

KIND = "observed-landcover-selections"
SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-landcover-selection/v1"
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
EDITION = "original-huc-nlcd-selection/1"


def _require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _relative(value):
    _require(isinstance(value, str) and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
             "Selected watershed members need original relative paths")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    _require(not path.is_absolute() and bool(path.parts) and ".." not in path.parts
             and path.as_posix() == value and all(":" not in part for part in path.parts),
             "Selected watershed member escapes its original directory")
    return value


def _same(first, second):
    return all(first.get(name) == second.get(name) for name in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _body(closure, descriptor):
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    return closure.read(descriptor["object"])


def _members(closure, entry, recipe):
    members = {}
    for descriptor in entry.get("companions", []):
        path = _relative(descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
        _require(path not in members, "Selected watershed source repeats a companion")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
        members[path] = descriptor
    requested = recipe.get("inputs")
    _require(isinstance(requested, list) and bool(requested),
             "Selected watershed report lacks its original input inventory")
    declared = {}
    for descriptor in requested:
        path = _relative(descriptor["path"])
        _require(path not in declared and path in members and _same(descriptor, members[path]),
                 "Selected watershed report lost an exact original input: " + path)
        declared[path] = descriptor
    _require(set(declared) == set(members),
             "Selected watershed report companion inventory differs")
    return members


def _captured(closure, collection_id, entry):
    recipe = _body(closure, entry["body"])
    origin = recipe.get("origin", {})
    key = identifier(origin.get("id"))
    project_id = origin.get("project_id")
    _require(entry.get("kind") == "document" and entry.get("role") == "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
             and recipe.get("schema") == REPORT_SCHEMA and recipe.get("edition") == EDITION
             and origin.get("kind") == KIND
             and (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("origin") == origin
             and isinstance(project_id, str) and bool(project_id)
             and entry.get("id") == "selected-huc-landcover-" + key
             and entry.get("uri") == "workspace://" + project_id + "/" + KIND + "/" + key,
             "Selected watershed report differs from its original producer")
    members = _members(closure, entry, recipe)

    def original(name):
        _require(name in members, "Selected watershed report lacks " + name)
        return _body(closure, members[name])

    report = original("selection.json")
    binding = original("original-inputs.json")
    selection = report.get("selection", {})
    hucs = selection.get("huc12s")
    _require(report.get("schema") == SCHEMA and report.get("edition") == EDITION
             and report.get("title") == recipe.get("title")
             and report.get("binding") == binding
             and isinstance(hucs, list) and bool(hucs)
             and all(isinstance(huc, str) and len(huc) == 12 and huc.isascii()
                     and huc.isdigit() for huc in hucs)
             and hucs == sorted(set(hucs)) and origin.get("huc12s") == hucs
             and origin.get("area_method") == "original_native_cell_centre"
             and [row.get("huc12") for row in report.get("watersheds", [])] == hucs,
             "Selected watershed report changed its original selection or support")
    for field in ("source_collection_id", "analysis_source_id", "analysis_sha256"):
        _require(selection.get(field) == binding.get(field),
                 "Selected watershed report changed its original " + field)
    identifier(binding["source_collection_id"])
    identifier(binding["analysis_sha256"])
    identifier(binding["source_domain_sha256"])
    originals = binding.get("inputs")
    _require(isinstance(originals, list) and len(originals) == 4,
             "Selected watershed report needs its four original completed input records")
    roster = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(originals):
        collection = identifier(row["source_collection_id"])
        source_id = row["source_id"]
        original_entry = row["entry"]
        _require(isinstance(source_id, str) and bool(source_id)
                 and original_entry.get("id") == source_id
                 and collection == binding["source_collection_id"],
                 "Selected watershed input changed its original collection or source")
        token = (collection, source_id)
        _require(token not in roster, "Selected watershed report repeats an original input")
        roster[token] = original_entry
        for descriptor in [original_entry["body"], *original_entry.get("companions", [])]:
            name = "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(
                descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
            _require(name in members and _same(descriptor, members[name]),
                     "Selected watershed report lost an original input body: " + name)
    analysis = roster.get((binding["source_collection_id"], binding["analysis_source_id"]))
    _require(analysis is not None
             and analysis["body"]["sha256"] == binding["analysis_sha256"],
             "Selected watershed report lost its exact original analysis-run identity")
    return origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster


def _local(closure, entry, origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster):
    key = origin["id"]
    prefix = KIND + "/" + key + "/"
    receipt = closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
    identity = receipt.get("identity", {})
    _require(receipt.get("schema") == SCHEMA and receipt.get("state") == "complete"
             and receipt.get("id") == key == digest(identity)
             and receipt.get("project_id") == origin["project_id"]
             and identity.get("project_id") == origin["project_id"]
             and identity.get("edition") == EDITION
             and identity.get("title") == receipt.get("title") == report["title"]
             and identity.get("selection") == report["selection"]
             and identity.get("binding") == binding
             and receipt.get("huc12s") == report["selection"]["huc12s"]
             and receipt.get("summary") == report.get("summary"),
             "Editable selected watershed receipt differs from its captured report")
    identifier(identity.get("producer_sha256"))
    files = receipt.get("files")
    _require(isinstance(files, dict) and bool(files),
             "Editable selected watershed comparison lacks its original files")
    extras = {"observed-report.json", "sources.json", "selected-huc-landcover.zip"}
    _require(set(files) == set(members) | extras,
             "Editable selected watershed file inventory changed")
    for name, descriptor in files.items():
        name = _relative(name)
        _require(descriptor.get("path") == prefix + name,
                 "Editable selected watershed file belongs to another comparison")
        if name in members:
            _require(_same(descriptor, members[name]),
                     "Editable selected watershed file differs from its captured source")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    _require(_same(files["observed-report.json"], entry["body"])
             and closure.read(prefix + "observed-report.json") == recipe
             and closure.read(prefix + "selection.json") == report
             and closure.read(prefix + "original-inputs.json") == binding,
             "Editable selected watershed originals differ from their report source")

    source = receipt["source"]
    source_collection = identifier(source["source_collection_id"])
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + source_collection + ".json")
    retained = [row for row in collection.get("entries", [])
                if row.get("id") == source.get("source_id")]
    _require(collection.get("schema") == "upstate.sources/v1"
             and digest(collection) == source_collection
             and source.get("source_id") == entry["id"] and len(retained) == 1
             and _same(retained[0]["body"], entry["body"]),
             "Editable selected watershed comparison lost its original report collection")
    native_members = {}
    for descriptor in retained[0].get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
        _require(name not in native_members, "Original selected report repeats a companion")
        native_members[name] = descriptor
    _require(set(native_members) == set(members)
             and all(_same(native_members[name], item) for name, item in members.items()),
             "Editable selected watershed report changed its captured companion set")
    observed_binding = receipt.get("observed_binding")
    # The ordinary observed binding uses its formatter binding edition rather
    # than this producer's edition. Compare its complete source/member portion.
    _require(isinstance(observed_binding, dict)
             and observed_binding.get("schema") == "upstate.observed-report-binding/v1"
             and isinstance(observed_binding.get("edition"), str)
             and bool(observed_binding["edition"])
             and observed_binding.get("source_collection_id") == source_collection
             and observed_binding.get("source_id") == entry["id"]
             and observed_binding.get("body_sha256") == entry["body"]["sha256"]
             and observed_binding.get("member_sha256") == {
                 **{name: item["sha256"] for name, item in native_members.items()},
                 _relative(retained[0]["body"].get("view_path", retained[0]["body"]["filename"])):
                     retained[0]["body"]["sha256"]},
             "Editable selected watershed scientific binding differs")
    required = {source_collection}
    for (collection_id, source_id), original in roster.items():
        current = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
        choices = [row for row in current.get("entries", []) if row.get("id") == source_id]
        _require(current.get("schema") == "upstate.sources/v1" and digest(current) == collection_id
                 and choices == [original],
                 "Editable selected watershed input differs from the captured original")
        required.add(collection_id)
        from .observed_landcover_local_copy import include_input

"""Portable CSV exports and the self-contained, offline operator report."""
from __future__ import annotations
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile

from .landcover_ledger import SCHEMA, LedgerError, sha256_file, atomic_json


def _csv(path: Path, columns: list[str], rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=columns, extrasaction="ignore")
        writer.writeheader()
        for record in rows:
            # Keep external zone/name labels from becoming spreadsheet formulae.
            safe = {k: ("'" + v if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith(("=", "+", "-", "@", "\t", "\r")) else v)
                    for k, v in record.items()}
            writer.writerow(safe)


def _source_edition_rows(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Bind readable annual-source labels to the actual retained raster inputs."""
    editions = report.get("source_editions")
    if editions is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(editions, dict) or (editions.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-source-editions/v1"
            or editions.get("input_mode") != "sources"
            or editions.get("area_method") != "fractional_polygon_overlap"
            or editions.get("binding_file") != "input-editions.json"):
        raise LedgerError("Unsupported original source-edition metadata")
    baseline, alternatives = editions.get("baseline"), editions.get("alternatives")
    if not isinstance(baseline, dict) or not isinstance(alternatives, list) or any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in alternatives):
        raise LedgerError("Retain the original baseline and alternative source editions")
    if baseline.get("key") != "baseline" or [row.get("key") for row in alternatives] != report["scenarios"]:
        raise LedgerError("Source-edition labels differ from the original comparison order")
    inputs = {row["role"]: row for row in report["inputs"]}
    rows = []
    for role, edition in [("baseline", baseline), *(("alternative", row) for row in alternatives)]:
        key = edition["key"]
        raster = edition.get("raster")
        retained = inputs.get("baseline" if role == "baseline" else "scenario:" + key)
        if (not isinstance(raster, dict) or retained is None
                or any(raster.get(field) != retained.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256"))):
            raise LedgerError("Source-edition metadata differs from its retained raster input")
        for field in ("label", "source_collection_id", "source_id"):
            if not isinstance(edition.get(field), str) or not edition[field]:
                raise LedgerError("A source edition is missing its original " + field)
        if isinstance(edition.get("band"), bool) or not isinstance(edition.get("band"), int) or edition["band"] < 1:
            raise LedgerError("A source edition must retain its original positive band number")
        for field in ("source_time", "source_crs", "units", "source_uri"):
            if edition.get(field) is not None and not isinstance(edition[field], str):
                raise LedgerError("Source-edition " + field + " must retain original text")
        rows.append({
            "role": role, "comparison_key": key, "label": edition["label"],
            "source_time": edition.get("source_time") or "",
            "source_collection_id": edition["source_collection_id"],
            "source_id": edition["source_id"], "band": edition["band"],
            "source_crs": edition.get("source_crs") or "",
            "units": edition.get("units") or "", "source_uri": edition.get("source_uri") or "",
            "raster_bytes": raster["bytes"], "raster_sha256": raster["sha256"],
        })
    return rows


def export_report(output: Path | str) -> dict:
    root = Path(output)
    report = json.loads((root / "ledger.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if report.get("schema") != SCHEMA or report.get("complete") is not True:
        raise LedgerError("Only complete land-cover ledgers may produce an operator report")
    source_rows = _source_edition_rows(report)
    if source_rows:
        binding_path = root / "input-editions.json"
        if not binding_path.is_file():
            raise LedgerError("Retain input-editions.json with the complete source comparison")
        identity = (binding_path.stat().st_size, sha256_file(binding_path))
        if not any(item.get("role") == "context" and
                   (item.get("bytes"), item.get("sha256")) == identity for item in report["inputs"]):
            raise LedgerError("The portable source binding differs from the computed ledger context")
        _csv(root / "source-editions.csv", list(source_rows[0]), source_rows)
    summary, transitions, groups, coverage, unknowns = [], [], [], [], []
    for row in report["rows"]:
        key = {k: row[k] for k in ("zone_id", "zone_name", "scenario")}
        summary.append({**key, **{k: row[k] for k in ("changed_ha", "unchanged_ha", "changed_pct_of_analysis", "analysis_coverage_pct")}, **row["support"]})
        for t in row["transitions"]:
            transitions.append({**key, **t, "from_class": report["classes"][str(t["from_code"])],
                                "to_class": report["classes"][str(t["to_code"])]})
        for group, values in row["groups"].items():
            groups.append({**key, "group": group, **values})
        coverage.append({**key, **row["support"]})
        for code, hectares in row["unknown_classes_ha"].items():
            side, value = code.split(":", 1)
            unknowns.append({**key, "side": side, "code": value, "ha": hectares})
    prefix = ["zone_id", "zone_name", "scenario"]
    _csv(root / "watershed-summary.csv", list(summary[0]), summary)
    _csv(root / "transitions.csv", prefix + ["from_code", "from_class", "to_code", "to_class", "ha", "intersecting_cells"], transitions)
    _csv(root / "landcover-groups.csv", prefix + ["group", "baseline_ha", "scenario_ha", "gained_ha", "lost_ha", "net_ha"], groups)
    _csv(root / "coverage.csv", list(coverage[0]), coverage)
    _csv(root / "unknown-classes.csv", prefix + ["side", "code", "ha"], unknowns)
    _csv(root / "zone-extent.csv", list(report["zones"][0]), report["zones"])
    if report.get("timeline") is not None:
        from .landcover_temporal import export_csv
        export_csv(root, report)
    template = Path(__file__).with_name("landcover_report.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    # JSON is parsed as data; escapes prevent external names closing the script.
    payload = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).replace("<", "\\u003c").replace("\u2028", "\\u2028").replace("\u2029", "\\u2029")
    (root / "report.html").write_text(template.replace("__LEDGER_DATA__", payload), encoding="utf-8")
    files = sorted([p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in (".json", ".csv", ".html", ".geojson", ".tif") and p.name not in ("export-manifest.json", "status.json")])
    manifest = {"schema": "upstate.landcover-export/1", "signature": report["signature"],
                "files": [{"path": p.name, "bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256_file(p)} for p in files]}
    atomic_json(root / "export-manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest


def make_portable(output: Path | str, destination: Path | str) -> dict:
    root, dest = Path(output).resolve(), Path(destination).resolve()
    manifest = export_report(root)
    if dest.exists():
        raise LedgerError(f"Portable destination already exists: {dest}")
    if dest.parent == root:
        raise LedgerError("Place portable ZIP outside its source ledger directory")
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = dest.with_name(dest.name + ".partial")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
            for item in manifest["files"]:
                archive.write(root / item["path"], item["path"])
            archive.write(root / "export-manifest.json", "export-manifest.json")
        temp.replace(dest)
    except BaseException:
        temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    return {"path": str(dest), "bytes": dest.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256_file(dest)}


def receive_portable(archive_path: Path | str, destination: Path | str) -> dict:
    """Create-only receiving, verifying every declared member before publication."""
    import tempfile
    import shutil
    destination = Path(destination).resolve()
    if destination.exists():
        raise LedgerError("Receiving never overwrites an existing directory")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".landcover-receive-", dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            infos = archive.infolist()
            names = [i.filename for i in infos]
            if len(names) != len(set(names)):
                raise LedgerError("Duplicate portable archive members")
            for name in names:
                if not name or name != Path(name).name or "\\" in name:
                    raise LedgerError(f"Unsafe portable member: {name!r}")
            manifest = json.loads(archive.read("export-manifest.json"))
            if manifest.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-export/1":
                raise LedgerError("Unsupported portable schema")
            expected = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["files"]}
            if len(expected) != len(manifest["files"]) or set(names) != set(expected) | {"export-manifest.json"}:
                raise LedgerError("Portable member inventory mismatch")
            for name, entry in expected.items():
                if archive.getinfo(name).file_size != entry["bytes"]:
                    raise LedgerError(f"Portable member length mismatch: {name}")
                with archive.open(name) as source, (temp / name).open("wb") as target:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, target, length=1024 * 1024)
                if sha256_file(temp / name) != entry["sha256"]:
                    raise LedgerError(f"Portable member digest mismatch: {name}")
            atomic_json(temp / "export-manifest.json", manifest)
            report = json.loads((temp / "ledger.json").read_text())
            if report.get("schema") != SCHEMA or report.get("complete") is not True or report.get("signature") != manifest["signature"]:
                raise LedgerError("Portable report identity mismatch")
        # mkdir reservation keeps a concurrent receiver from replacing a winner.
        destination.mkdir()
        try:
            for path in temp.iterdir():
                path.replace(destination / path.name)
        except BaseException:
            shutil.rmtree(destination)
            raise
        return {"path": str(destination), "signature": manifest["signature"], "files": len(names)}
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)

"""CLI for the existing-grid land-cover accounting consumer."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from .landcover_ledger import LedgerError, Options, RasterInput, run_ledger, run_native_workspace
from .landcover_exports import export_report, make_portable, receive_portable


def mapping_args(values: list[str], parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> dict[str, str]:
    result = {}
    for entry in values:
        if "=" not in entry:
            parser.error("Scenario selection must be NAME=PATH")
        name, path = entry.split("=", 1)
        if not name.strip() or not path or name in result:
            parser.error("Scenario names must be nonempty and unique; paths are required")
        result[name] = path
    return result



def _workspace_command(args):
    """Use the original retained Workspace, reducer and portable readers."""
    import os
    import subprocess
    from .workspace import Workspace
    from . import landcover_workspace
    from .common import atomic_json, file_digest, read_json, verify_file
    from .portable import backup, inspect_archive, restore

    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
    result_path = args.result.expanduser().resolve() if args.result else None
    if result_path and result_path.is_relative_to(workspace.root):
        raise LedgerError("Save the operation result outside the original Workspace")
    selection_path = getattr(args, "selection", None)
    if result_path and selection_path and result_path == selection_path.expanduser().resolve():
        raise LedgerError("Keep the exact input selection JSON separate from the operation result")
    receive_root = getattr(args, "receive_report", None)
    restore_root = getattr(args, "restore", None)
    archive_path = getattr(args, "archive", None)
    targets = [path.expanduser().resolve() for path in (receive_root, restore_root) if path]
    if any(path.is_relative_to(workspace.root) or workspace.root.is_relative_to(path) for path in targets):
        raise LedgerError("Receiving destinations must be separate from the original Workspace and its ancestors")
    if len(targets) == 2 and (targets[0].is_relative_to(targets[1]) or targets[1].is_relative_to(targets[0])):
        raise LedgerError("Choose separate report and Workspace receiving directories")
    if result_path and any(result_path.is_relative_to(path) for path in targets):
        raise LedgerError("Save operation JSON outside the verified receiving directories")
    if archive_path:
        archive_path = archive_path.expanduser().resolve()
        if result_path == archive_path or any(archive_path.is_relative_to(path) for path in targets):
            raise LedgerError("Keep archive and operation JSON separate from receiving directories")
    if args.workspace_command == "catalog":
        result = landcover_workspace.catalog(workspace)
    elif args.workspace_command == "preview":
        selection = json.loads(args.selection.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        result = landcover_workspace.preview_inputs(workspace, selection)
    else:
        if args.workspace_command == "build":
            selection = json.loads(args.selection.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
            def progress(status):
                print(json.dumps(status, separators=(",", ":")), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
            edition = landcover_workspace.build(workspace, selection, progress=progress)
            inspected = landcover_workspace.inspect(workspace, edition["id"])
        else:
            inspected = landcover_workspace.inspect(workspace, args.id)
            edition = inspected["edition"]
        directory = workspace.root / landcover_workspace.KIND / edition["id"]
        result = {
            "schema": "upstate.landcover-workspace-operation/v1",
            "workspace": str(workspace.root), "project": workspace.project,
            "edition": edition, "binding": inspected["binding"],
            "report": {"path": str(directory / edition["files"]["ledger.json"]["path"]),
                       "signature": inspected["report"]["signature"],
                       "rows": len(inspected["report"]["rows"]),
                       "source_editions": inspected["report"].get("source_editions")},
            "report_archive": {"path": str(directory / edition["files"]["archive"]["path"]),
                               **{key: edition["files"]["archive"][key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")}},
        }

        if args.receive_report:
            report_root = args.receive_report.expanduser().resolve()
            archive = verify_file(directory, edition["files"]["archive"])
            if report_root.exists():
                # A retry reopens the exact already-received native export.
                manifest = read_json(report_root / "export-manifest.json")
                original_manifest = read_json(
                    verify_file(directory, edition["files"]["export-manifest.json"]))
                if manifest != original_manifest:
                    raise LedgerError("Existing report destination belongs to another export")
                expected = {row["path"] for row in manifest["files"]} | {"export-manifest.json"}
                if {path.name for path in report_root.iterdir()} != expected:
                    raise LedgerError("Existing received report has a different member inventory")
                for descriptor in manifest["files"]:
                    verify_file(report_root, descriptor)
                received_report = {"path": str(report_root), "signature": manifest["signature"],
                                   "files": len(expected), "reused": True}
            else:
                received_report = {**receive_portable(archive, report_root), "reused": False}
            received = read_json(report_root / "ledger.json")
            if received != inspected["report"]:
                raise LedgerError("Received report differs from the original computed ledger")
            if inspected["binding"].get("schema") == "upstate.landcover-source-binding/v1":
                if read_json(report_root / "input-editions.json") != inspected["binding"]:
                    raise LedgerError("Received report changed its original annual source binding")
            result["received_report"] = received_report

        if args.archive:
            archive = args.archive.expanduser().resolve()
            destination = args.restore.expanduser().resolve()
            if archive.is_relative_to(workspace.root) or destination.is_relative_to(workspace.root):
                raise LedgerError("Place the portable archive and restored project outside the original Workspace")
            if archive.is_relative_to(destination):
                raise LedgerError("Keep the portable archive outside its receiving destination")
            if archive.exists():
                manifest = inspect_archive(archive, verify=True)
                archive_reused = True
            else:
                backup(workspace, archive)
                manifest = inspect_archive(archive, verify=True)
                archive_reused = False
            if manifest["project"] != workspace.project:
                raise LedgerError("Existing archive belongs to another original project")
            member = "workspace/" + landcover_workspace.KIND + "/" + edition["id"] + "/edition.json"
            descriptor = manifest["members"].get(member)
            edition_path = directory / "edition.json"
            if (not descriptor or descriptor["bytes"] != edition_path.stat().st_size
                    or descriptor["sha256"] != file_digest(edition_path)):
                raise LedgerError("Workspace archive does not retain this exact complete ledger edition")
            if destination.exists():
                restored = Workspace(destination / "workspace")
                restoration = {"workspace": str(restored.root),
                               "application": str(destination / "application"), "reused": True}
            else:
                restoration = {**restore(archive, destination), "reused": False}
                restored = Workspace(restoration["workspace"])
            if restored.project != workspace.project:
                raise LedgerError("Restored Workspace changed the original project identity")
            reopened = landcover_workspace.inspect(restored, edition["id"])
            if reopened != inspected:
                raise LedgerError("Restored original sources or computed ledger differ from the archived edition")
            application = destination / "application"
            command = [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "model.landcover_cli", "workspace",
                       "--workspace", str(restored.root), "inspect", edition["id"]]
            environment = dict(os.environ)
            # Resolve the transferred application's modules from its own cwd.
            environment.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
            cold = subprocess.run(command, cwd=application, env=environment,
                                  capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
            if cold.returncode:
                detail = (cold.stderr or cold.stdout or "No process diagnostic").strip()
                raise LedgerError("Restored application inspect exited "
                                  + str(cold.returncode) + ": " + detail)
            try:
                native_result = json.loads(cold.stdout)
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise LedgerError("Restored application returned invalid inspection JSON: "
                                  + cold.stderr.strip()) from exc
            if (native_result.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-workspace-operation/v1"
                    or native_result.get("project") != workspace.project
                    or native_result.get("edition") != edition
                    or native_result.get("binding") != inspected["binding"]
                    or native_result.get("report", {}).get("signature") != inspected["report"]["signature"]
                    or native_result.get("report", {}).get("source_editions") != inspected["report"].get("source_editions")):
                raise LedgerError("Restored application changed the retained edition or its source interpretation")
            result["workspace_archive"] = {"path": str(archive), "bytes": archive.stat().st_size,
                                           "sha256": file_digest(archive), "reused": archive_reused,
                                           "members": len(manifest["members"])}
            result["restored"] = {**restoration, "project": restored.project,
                                  "edition_id": reopened["edition"]["id"],
                                  "binding_sha256": reopened["edition"]["binding_sha256"],
                                  "signature": reopened["report"]["signature"],
                                  "source_identity": "MATCH",
                                  "application_inspection": {"command": command,
                                                             "application": str(application),
                                                             "returncode": cold.returncode,
                                                             "stderr": cold.stderr,
                                                             "edition_id": native_result["edition"]["id"],
                                                             "binding_sha256": native_result["edition"]["binding_sha256"],
                                                             "signature": native_result["report"]["signature"]}}

    if args.result:
        target = args.result.expanduser().resolve()
        if target.is_relative_to(workspace.root):
            raise LedgerError("Save the operation result outside the original Workspace")
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        atomic_json(target, result)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    run = commands.add_parser("run", help="Account against original aligned raster files")
    source = run.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path, help="Native root with rasters/landcover.tif and huc12.geojson")
    source.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path)
    run.add_argument("--zones", type=Path, help="Required with --baseline")
    run.add_argument("--scenario", action="append", default=[], metavar="NAME=PATH", required=True)
    run.add_argument("--baseline-band", type=int, default=1)
    run.add_argument("--scenario-band", action="append", default=[], metavar="NAME=BAND")
    run.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    run.add_argument("--context", action="append", type=Path, default=[])
    run.add_argument("--id-field", default="huc12")
    run.add_argument("--name-field", default="name")
    run.add_argument("--zone-crs")
    run.add_argument("--tile-size", type=int, default=512)
    run.add_argument("--support", choices=("all", "pair"), default="all")
    run.add_argument("--unknown-policy", choices=("error", "exclude"), default="error")
    run.add_argument("--allow-overlap", action="store_true")
    run.add_argument("--allow-projected-area", action="store_true")
    run.add_argument("--no-rasters", action="store_true")
    run.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    run.add_argument("--title", default="Land-cover change ledger")
    report = commands.add_parser("report", help="Regenerate exports from a retained complete ledger")
    report.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    pack = commands.add_parser("pack", help="Export a complete portable report and raster edition")
    pack.add_argument("output", type=Path); pack.add_argument("destination", type=Path)
    receive = commands.add_parser("receive", help="Verify and receive a portable edition create-only")
    receive.add_argument("archive", type=Path); receive.add_argument("destination", type=Path)
    native = commands.add_parser("workspace", help="Use original imported sources, saved runs and portable Workspace editions")
    native.add_argument("--workspace", type=Path, required=True)
    native_commands = native.add_subparsers(dest="workspace_command", required=True)
    for operation, help_text in (
            ("catalog", "List original raster sources, reporting polygons, runs and editions"),
            ("preview", "Inspect exact source bands, grid compatibility and reporting selection"),
            ("build", "Build and reopen the complete original Workspace ledger"),
            ("inspect", "Verify and reopen an existing complete Workspace ledger")):
        command = native_commands.add_parser(operation, help=help_text)
        command.add_argument("--result", type=Path, help="Save complete operation JSON outside the original Workspace")
        if operation in ("preview", "build"):
            command.add_argument("--selection", type=Path, required=True,
                                 help="Original exact source-mode or run-mode selection JSON")
        if operation == "inspect":
            command.add_argument("id", help="Original retained land-cover edition ID")
        if operation in ("build", "inspect"):
            command.add_argument("--receive-report", type=Path, help="Create or verify the original portable report directory")
            command.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, help="Create or verify a complete original Workspace ZIP")
            command.add_argument("--restore", type=Path, help="Create or verify its separately restored project directory")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "workspace":
            if args.workspace_command in ("build", "inspect") and bool(args.archive) != bool(args.restore):
                parser.error("--archive and --restore must be supplied together")
            return _workspace_command(args)
        if args.command == "run":
            selections = mapping_args(args.scenario, parser)
            bands = mapping_args(args.scenario_band, parser)
            if set(bands) - set(selections):
                parser.error("Scenario band selection names must match --scenario names")
            try:
                specs = {name: RasterInput(path, int(bands.get(name, "1"))) for name, path in selections.items()}
            except ValueError:
                parser.error("Scenario band values must be integers")
            options = Options(tile_size=args.tile_size, support_scope=args.support,
                              unknown_policy=args.unknown_policy, allow_overlap=args.allow_overlap,
                              allow_projected_area=args.allow_projected_area, write_rasters=not args.no_rasters,
                              resume=args.resume, title=args.title)
            contexts = list(args.context)
            if args.workspace:
                if args.zones:
                    parser.error("Use --baseline with an explicit --zones override")
                baseline_path = args.workspace / "rasters" / "landcover.tif"
                zones_path = args.workspace / "huc12.geojson"
                contexts.extend(args.workspace / p for p in ("run_manifest.json", "grid.json", "scenario_set.json") if (args.workspace / p).is_file())
            else:
                if not args.zones:
                    parser.error("--baseline requires --zones")
                baseline_path, zones_path = args.baseline, args.zones
            def progress(status):
                print(json.dumps(status, separators=(",", ":")), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
            result = run_ledger(RasterInput(baseline_path, args.baseline_band), specs, zones_path, args.output,
                                options=options, id_field=args.id_field, name_field=args.name_field,
                                zone_crs=args.zone_crs, context_files=contexts, progress=progress)
            export_report(args.output)
            print(json.dumps({"output": str(args.output), "signature": result["signature"],
                              "watersheds": len(result["zones"])-1, "scenarios": len(result["scenarios"])}))
        elif args.command == "report":
            print(json.dumps(export_report(args.output)))
        elif args.command == "pack":
            print(json.dumps(make_portable(args.output, args.destination)))
        elif args.command == "receive":
            print(json.dumps(receive_portable(args.archive, args.destination)))
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Interrupted. Committed windows remain in the ledger; rerun with --resume.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 130
    except (LedgerError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"Land-cover ledger: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

"""Editable original land-cover ledgers behind selected scientific reports.

This joins the maintained Study closure through raw CAS records. It does not
materialize source views, open raster datasets, render reports or run a reducer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier

SOURCE_SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-report-source/v1"
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
EDITION_SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-edition/v1"
SOURCE_BINDING = "upstate.landcover-source-binding/v1"
RUN_BINDING = "upstate.landcover-binding/v1"
REPORT_ROOT = "landcover-report-sources"
LEDGER_ROOT = "landcover-ledgers"


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source needs canonical relative member paths")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in item for item in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source member escapes its original directory")
    return value


def _same_file(first, second):
    return all(first.get(field) == second.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _body(closure, descriptor):
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    return closure.read(descriptor["object"])


def _captured(closure, entry):
    recipe = _body(closure, entry["body"])
    metadata = entry["metadata"]
    origin = recipe.get("origin")
    if not isinstance(origin, dict) or origin.get("schema") != SOURCE_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover report lost its original producer identity")
    source_id = identifier(origin.get("id"))
    ledger_id = identifier(origin.get("ledger_id"))
    project_id = origin.get("project_id")
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
            or recipe.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA or metadata.get("origin") != origin
            or not isinstance(project_id, str) or not project_id
            or entry.get("id") != "landcover-ledger-" + source_id
            or entry.get("uri") != "workspace://" + project_id + "/landcover-ledgers/" + ledger_id):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover report source differs from its original producer")
    members = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source repeats an original companion")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    selected = set()
    requested = recipe.get("inputs")
    if not isinstance(requested, list) or not requested:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source must retain its original inputs")
    for item in requested:
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if name in selected or name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an exact original input: " + name)
        selected.add(name)
    if selected != set(members):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source companion inventory differs from its recipe")

    def original(name):
        if name not in members:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks original member: " + name)
        return _body(closure, members[name])

    edition = original("ledger/edition.json")
    binding = original("ledger/input-bindings.json")
    report = original("ledger/results/ledger.json")
    originals = original("records/source-bindings.json")
    if (edition.get("schema") != EDITION_SCHEMA or edition.get("id") != ledger_id
            or edition.get("workspace_id") != project_id or edition.get("state") != "complete"
            or binding.get("workspace_id") != project_id or digest(binding) != ledger_id
            or edition.get("binding_sha256") != ledger_id
            or edition.get("selection") != binding.get("selection")
            or edition.get("grid_id") != binding.get("grid_id")
            or edition.get("signature") != origin.get("signature")
            or report.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-ledger/1"
            or report.get("signature") != origin.get("signature") or report.get("complete") is not True
            or originals.get("schema") != "upstate.landcover-report-originals/v1"
            or originals.get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or origin.get("area_method") != "fractional_polygon_overlap"
            or origin.get("area_basis") != report.get("grid", {}).get("area_basis")):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its saved ledger or original binding")
    selection = binding["selection"]
    source_mode = selection.get("input_mode") == "sources"
    if (binding.get("schema") != (SOURCE_BINDING if source_mode else RUN_BINDING)
            or origin.get("input_mode") != selection.get("input_mode", "runs")):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original operand mode")
    if source_mode and (binding.get("grid_id") is not None
                        or original("ledger/results/input-editions.json") != binding):
        raise ValueError("Annual-source ledger lost its exact portable source binding")
    files = edition.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, dict) or not files:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks its completed original artifacts")
    for item in files.values():
        name = "ledger/" + _relative(item["path"])
        if name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an original ledger artifact: " + name)
    for role, path in (("binding", "input-bindings.json"), ("ledger.json", "results/ledger.json"),
                       ("original_zones", "zones-original.geojson")):
        if files.get(role, {}).get("path") != path:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed an original artifact role")
    operands = binding.get("operands")
    if not isinstance(operands, list) or len(operands) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source needs its ordered baseline and alternatives")
    if edition.get("alternative_count") != len(operands) - 1:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original alternative count")
    if not source_mode and [row.get("run_id") for row in operands] != [
            selection.get("baseline_run_id"), *selection.get("alternative_run_ids", [])]:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its ordered native runs")
    if source_mode:
        references = [selection.get("baseline_source"), *selection.get("alternative_sources", [])]
        if [row.get("source_selection") for row in operands] != references:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its ordered raster sources or bands")
        keys = ["source-" + digest(choice)[:20] for choice in references[1:]]
    else:
        keys = [row["run_id"] for row in operands[1:]]
    if report.get("scenarios") != keys:
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original computed alternative order")
    return origin, recipe, members, edition, binding, report, originals


def _original_entries(closure, binding, originals, members, *, local):
    requested = [(binding["zones"]["selection"], binding["zones"]["source_entry"])]
    if binding["schema"] == SOURCE_BINDING:
        requested.extend((row["source_selection"], row["source_entry"]) for row in binding["operands"])
    expected = {}
    for choice, entry in requested:
        collection_id = identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
        key = (collection_id, choice["source_id"])
        if key in expected and expected[key] != entry:
            raise ValueError("Land-cover operands disagree about an original source entry")
        expected[key] = entry
    captured = {}
    for row in originals.get("sources", []):
        key = (identifier(row["source_collection_id"]), row["source_id"])
        if key in captured or expected.get(key) != row.get("entry"):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source changed its original source roster")
        captured[key] = row["entry"]
        prefix = "originals/" + key[0] + "/" + digest(key[1]) + "/"
        for item in [row["entry"]["body"], *row["entry"].get("companions", [])]:
            name = prefix + _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
            if name not in members or not _same_file(item, members[name]):
                raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost an original source body: " + name)
        if local:
            collection = closure.read("sources/" + key[0] + ".json")
            entries = [entry for entry in collection.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id") == key[1]]
            if (collection.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(collection) != key[0]
                    or entries != [row["entry"]]):
                raise ValueError("Editable land-cover input differs from its captured source")
            closure.need("sources", key[0], "Original land-cover raster or reporting source")
    if set(captured) != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source omitted an original input edition")
    return [{"kind": "sources", "id": key} for key in sorted({pair[0] for pair in expected})]


def _native_members(closure, binding, report, originals, members, *, local):
    native = originals.get("native_raster_members")
    if not isinstance(native, list):
        raise ValueError("Land-cover source lacks its native dependency inventory")
    if binding["schema"] == SOURCE_BINDING:
        if native:
            raise ValueError("Annual-source ledger unexpectedly declares native run members")
        return []
    accepted = {(item["bytes"], item["sha256"]) for item in report["inputs"]
                if item["role"] == "baseline" or item["role"].startswith("scenario:")
                or item["role"] == "raster-companion"}
    paths = {}
    for item in native:
        path = _relative(item["path"])
        if (path in paths or (item["bytes"], item["sha256"]) not in accepted
                or "run-rasters/" + path not in members
                or not _same_file(item, members["run-rasters/" + path])):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover native raster differs from its computed input")
        paths[path] = item
        if local:
            closure.add_file(path, item)
    for operand in binding["operands"]:
        raster = operand["raster"]
        if raster["path"] not in paths or not _same_file(paths[raster["path"]], raster):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover source lost a native baseline or alternative raster")
    if not local:
        return []
    grid_id = identifier(binding["grid_id"])
    grid = closure.read("grids/" + grid_id + "/grid.json")
    if (grid.get("id") != grid_id or grid.get("grid") != binding["grid_definition"]
            or grid.get("spec") != binding["grid_spec"]):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover prepared grid differs from its binding")
    closure.need("grids", grid_id, "Original prepared grid for retained land-cover ledger")
    required = [{"kind": "grids", "id": grid_id}]
    for operand in binding["operands"]:
        run_id = identifier(operand["run_id"])
        run = closure.read("runs/" + run_id + "/run.json")
        if (run.get("id") != run_id or run.get("selection") != operand["selection"]
                or digest(run["selection"]) != run_id
                or run["selection"].get("grid_id") != grid_id):
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover run differs from its captured selection")
        scenario_id = identifier(run["selection"]["scenario_id"])
        scenario = closure.read("scenarios/" + scenario_id + ".json")
        if digest(scenario) != scenario_id or {**scenario, "id": scenario_id} != operand["scenario"]:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover scenario differs from its captured edition")
        if operand["basis"] == "retained_landcover_stage":
            descriptor = run.get("stages", {}).get("landcover", {}).get("artifact")
            if not isinstance(descriptor, dict):
                raise ValueError("Original land-cover stage artifact is missing")
            current = {**descriptor, "path": "runs/" + run_id + "/" + _relative(descriptor["path"])}
        elif operand["basis"] == "retained_grid_NLCD":
            descriptor = grid["files"]["NLCD"]
            current = {**descriptor, "path": "grids/" + grid_id + "/" + _relative(descriptor["path"])}
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unknown original land-cover raster basis")
        if current != operand["raster"]:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover raster descriptor changed")
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original selected run for saved land-cover ledger")
        required.append({"kind": "runs", "id": run_id})
    return required


def _local(closure, collection_id, entry, origin, recipe, members, edition, binding):
    key, ledger_id = origin["id"], origin["ledger_id"]
    prefix = REPORT_ROOT + "/" + key + "/"
    receipt = closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
    if (receipt.get("schema") != SOURCE_SCHEMA or receipt.get("state") != "complete"
            or receipt.get("id") != key or digest(receipt.get("selection")) != key
            or receipt["selection"].get("project_id") != origin["project_id"]
            or receipt.get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or receipt["selection"].get("ledger_id") != ledger_id
            or receipt["selection"].get("signature") != origin["signature"]
            or receipt.get("title") != recipe.get("title")):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report receipt differs from its source")
    source = receipt["source"]
    original_collection_id = identifier(source["source_collection_id"])
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + original_collection_id + ".json")
    original = [row for row in collection.get("entries", []) if row.get("id") == source.get("source_id")]
    if (digest(collection) != original_collection_id or len(original) != 1
            or source.get("source_id") != entry["id"]
            or not _same_file(original[0]["body"], entry["body"])):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report lost its original imported source")
    original_members = {}
    for item in original[0].get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in original_members:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report repeats a source companion")
        original_members[name] = item
    if (set(original_members) != set(members)
            or any(not _same_file(original_members[name], item) for name, item in members.items())):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report lost its original imported source")
    closure.need("sources", original_collection_id, "Original imported land-cover report source")
    retained = receipt.get("members")
    if not isinstance(retained, dict) or set(retained) != set(members):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover source changed its member roster")
    for name, descriptor in retained.items():
        if descriptor.get("path") != prefix + name or not _same_file(descriptor, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover source changed an original member")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    for descriptor in receipt["files"].values():
        path = _relative(descriptor["path"])
        if not path.startswith(prefix):
            raise ValueError("Land-cover report file belongs to another original source")
        closure.add_file(path, descriptor)
    if (receipt["files"]["recipe"]["path"] != prefix + "landcover-report.json"
            or not _same_file(receipt["files"]["recipe"], entry["body"])
            or closure.read(prefix + "landcover-report.json") != recipe):
        raise ValueError("Editable land-cover report recipe differs from its source")
    ledger_prefix = LEDGER_ROOT + "/" + ledger_id + "/"
    for name, expected in (("edition.json", edition), ("input-bindings.json", binding)):
        closure.add_file(ledger_prefix + name, members["ledger/" + name])
        if closure.read(ledger_prefix + name) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Editable land-cover ledger changed its original " + name)
    for descriptor in edition["files"].values():
        closure.add_file(ledger_prefix + _relative(descriptor["path"]), descriptor)
    # Capture the original completed reducer database/checkpoints as well as every
    # declared report artifact. The maintained closure detects concurrent changes.
    closure.tree(ledger_prefix.rstrip("/"))
    closure.tree(prefix.rstrip("/"))
    return original_collection_id


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Follow this producer only for an explicitly ordered saved-report source."""
    source_kind = (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("source_kind")
    if source_kind == "observed-landcover-selections":
        from . import observed_landcover_study_transfer
        return observed_landcover_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)

        "source_entries": [{"source_collection_id": row["source_collection_id"],
                            "source_id": row["source_id"], "body_sha256": row["entry"]["body"]["sha256"]}

    closure.report_source_records[token] = record
    return True

def install(destination: Path) -> dict:
    root = destination.expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
    if not (root / 'model').is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Destination must be the existing application with a model/ directory')
    bundle = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    with (root / '.landcover-install.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        pending, existing, inventory = [], [], []
        for name in FILES:
            target = root / name
            if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError(f'Target escapes the original application: {name}')
            data = (bundle / name).read_bytes()
            previous = None
            if target.exists():
                previous = target.read_bytes()
                if previous == data:
                    existing.append(name)
                elif hashlib.sha256(previous).hexdigest() in PREVIOUS.get(name, ()):
                    pending.append((target, data, previous))
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f'Differing existing source: {name}; reconcile the actual current file')
            else:
                pending.append((target, data, None))
            inventory.append({'path': name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
        # Extend the current Team policy instead of replacing another desk's routes.
        policy_path = root / 'operator/team_route_policy.json'
        if policy_path.exists():
            if policy_path.is_symlink() or not policy_path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
                raise ValueError('Team route policy escapes the original application')
            previous = policy_path.read_bytes()
            policy = json.loads(previous)
            routes = policy.get('safeViewerPosts')
            if not isinstance(routes, list) or any(not isinstance(row, str) for row in routes):
                raise ValueError('Retain the original Team safeViewerPosts list')
            route = '/api/landcover-ledger/inputs'
            if route not in routes:
                policy['safeViewerPosts'] = sorted([*routes, route])
                data = (json.dumps(policy, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
                pending.append((policy_path, data, previous))
            else:
                data = previous
                existing.append('operator/team_route_policy.json')
            inventory.append({'path': 'operator/team_route_policy.json', 'bytes': len(data),
                              'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
        for target, data, previous in pending:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('Concurrent target directory changed')
            temporary = None
            try:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, prefix='.landcover-source-', delete=False) as out:
                    temporary = Path(out.name)
                    out.write(data); out.flush(); os.fsync(out.fileno())
                if previous is None:
                    try:
                        os.link(temporary, target)
                    except FileExistsError:
                        if target.read_bytes() != data:
                            raise ValueError(f'Concurrent differing publication: {target.relative_to(root)}')
                else:
                    if target.read_bytes() != previous:
                        raise ValueError(f'Concurrent differing publication: {target.relative_to(root)}')
                    os.replace(temporary, target)
            finally:
                if temporary is not None:
                    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return {'application': str(root), 'version': '1.4.1',
                'added': [str(p.relative_to(root)) for p, _, old in pending if old is None],
                'upgraded': [str(p.relative_to(root)) for p, _, old in pending if old is not None],
                'reused': existing, 'files': inventory}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('application', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        print(json.dumps(install(args.application), indent=2))
    except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:
        parser.exit(2, f'Land-cover installation: {exc}\n')
